cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(DshDebugFixture LANGUAGES CXX)
add_executable(DshDebugFixture main.cpp)
set_property(DIRECTORY PROPERTY VS_STARTUP_PROJECT DshDebugFixture)
target_compile_features(DshDebugFixture PRIVATE cxx_std_17)
if(MSVC)
  target_compile_options(DshDebugFixture PRIVATE /Od /Zi)
  target_link_options(DshDebugFixture PRIVATE /DEBUG)
endif()
